expectedKindLogic: scripts/doc-standard.spec.ts expectedKind(file): normalize slashes; (1) if path has <=3 '/'-segments -> 'package-group' (i.e. packages/README.md or packages/<group>/README.md); (2) else derive dir via packageDir() (strip /README.md or /README.zh.md); (3) if declaresBundle(dir) [package.json dsh.bundle.patch !== undefined] -> 'package-bundle'; (4) else if dir in PACKAGE_LIBRARIES registry (41 hand-audited entries: boot/*, client/store|ui-primitives|ui-slots|web, core/scope, experimental/webworker-*, hooks/hook-protocol, identity/anonymous-user-id, sandbox/*, sdk/*, session/session-format*, session-telemetry, session-title-llm, subagent/subagent-in-process-driver, subprocess/win32-process, test-support/*, typert/*, util/*) -> 'package-library'; (5) else -> 'package-reference' (the default for a Cordis-plugin package at packages/<group>/<pkg>). Two spec tests consume this: 'maps package README kinds...' (frontmatter kind must === expectedKind, description must be non-empty string, and name/audience/tags/i18n must be absent) and 'keeps every package README on the summary, contents, and Dev Note skeleton' (for depth==4 files only: EN needs ^## Summary$, ^## Table of Contents$, ^#{2,3} Dev Note$; ZH needs 概述/目录/开发备注). VERIFIED: all 65 missing files are depth-4 (packages/<group>/<pkg>/README.md), none declare a bundle, none appear in PACKAGE_LIBRARIES -> every one of the 65 resolves to kind 'package-reference'.
kindInference: All 65 target packages resolve to kind 'package-reference' (depth-4, no dsh.bundle.patch, none in PACKAGE_LIBRARIES). Generator rule: group iff depth<=3; bundle iff dsh.bundle.patch; library iff in frozen PACKAGE_LIBRARIES set; else reference.
optionCToolPlan: scripts/gen-package-readme-skeleton.ts, modeled 1:1 on scripts/gen-tsconfig-paths.ts (write vs --check-drift-gate self-maintenance pattern, already wired as gen-tsconfig-paths + verify-tsconfig-paths in package.json). FLOW: (1) enumerate targets via the SAME PACKAGE_README_GLOBS as doc-standard.spec.ts (packages/*/*/README.md + .zh.md, exclude node_modules); (2) for each, compute kind by re-implementing/importing expectedKind() (depth<=3 group; dsh.bundle.patch bundle; PACKAGE_LIBRARIES library; else reference) so tool and gate can never disagree; (3) DERIVE description: read the sibling package.json 'description' field (VERIFIED present and non-empty on all 65) as the EN frontmatter description verbatim (or lightly trimmed to one sentence); for the .zh.md side prefer an existing zh description if present else reuse EN and emit a TODO-translate marker for the author — never machine-translate silently; (4) FRONTMATTER: if the file already starts with '---' leave metadata alone (idempotent); else prepend a 3-line block: ---\\ndescription: \"<desc>\"\\nkind: \"<kind>\"\\n---\\n (order/quoting matching packages/bundle/data-agent/README.md exemplar; MUST NOT add name/audience/tags/i18n — those fail the redundant-field check); (5) SKELETON HEADINGS: these 65 already carry ## Model Experience + ## Known Limitations and Deferred Work (VERIFIED 65/65, so the model-experience and limitations gates stay satisfied) but lack ## Summary / ## Table of Contents / ## Dev Note (VERIFIED 0/65). Tool INSERTS the 3 missing standard headings around existing content, non-destructively: '## Summary' (seeded with the package.json description as placeholder prose), '## Table of Contents' (auto-built anchor list from existing ## headings), and a '## Dev Note' (or '### Dev Note') block near the end — leaving all package-specific sections (Overview/Run/Status/Model Experience/Known Limitations) intact. Same for .zh.md with 概述/目录/开发备注. Body prose beyond the placeholder is left as 'TODO: fill in Summary...' for the package owner. (6) BILINGUAL PAIRING: after writing each pair, shell out to `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write packages/<group>/<pkg>/README.md` (per-pair) to re-record the git-blob hashes in the existing README.i18n.yaml sidecar (VERIFIED 65/65 sidecars already present) — do NOT enforce physical line-alignment for these (only the reference-example pair session-persistence-jsonl is line-aligned-locked). (7) MODES: default writes 130 files; `--check` reports drift (missing frontmatter / missing standard headings) and exits non-zero, wired as a new `verify-package-readme-skeleton` gate so future new packages fail a gate instead of silently missing skeleton. Runs once over all 65 pkgs -> 130 files.
descriptionPolicy: Source the frontmatter `description` from each package's existing package.json `description` field (VERIFIED non-empty on all 65/65) rather than hand-writing — this is the single source of truth already curated per package (e.g. nl2sql-engine, llm-dashscope, query-maxcompute all have rich domain-term descriptions). Policy: EN frontmatter description = package.json description, trimmed to one or two concrete sentences with searchable domain terms (per package-reference template rule), preserving normative terms and existing bracket tags like [data-agent]; wrap in double quotes matching the exemplar. ZH frontmatter description = a human/authored Chinese rendering (the exemplar packages/bundle/data-agent/README.zh.md shows a hand-localized description, not a machine copy); when no zh description exists the tool seeds the EN text plus a visible TODO-translate marker for the owner — never silently machine-translate, to respect the intranet controlled-English + equal-authority-bilingual discipline. Must satisfy doc-standard: description is a non-empty string and the block carries ONLY description+kind (no name/audience/tags/i18n).

optionRecommend.costA: ~150K tokens / ~1-2 sessions: hand-edit 130 files (65 md + 65 zh) prepending frontmatter and inserting 3 headings each; high risk of mechanical drift, quoting/heading-name mistakes, and forgetting per-pair verify-translation-pairing --write; no guard against future new packages missing skeleton.
optionRecommend.costB: ~5-8 sessions spread across P4-P11 phase-owners, 1 package-group per session; Gate 3 stays KNOWN-RED for weeks, partial progress hard to track, coordination overhead, same per-file mechanical risk as A but amortized.
optionRecommend.costC: ~40K tokens / ~2-3 sessions: build scripts/gen-package-readme-skeleton.ts (clone of gen-tsconfig-paths.ts write/--check pattern), run once to emit all 130 files deriving kind from expectedKind() and description from package.json, auto-record pairing, then add a verify-package-readme-skeleton --check gate; one review pass over generated placeholders.
optionRecommend.rationale: C wins decisively here because the retrofit is almost pure mechanism and the inputs are already structured: kind is a deterministic constant (all 65 = package-reference) computable from the SAME expectedKind() the gate uses, and description already exists in every package.json (65/65 verified). A generator eliminates A's per-file drift risk and B's long-red-gate coordination cost, and — matching the ticket's stated preference and the gen-tsconfig-paths precedent — leaves behind a --check gate so new fork packages fail fast instead of silently regressing Gate 3. The ~40K vs ~150K plan estimate is credible; the tool's marginal cost over hand-editing is recovered on the first future package. The only residual human work is authoring Summary prose and zh description translations, which no option avoids.

recommendation: Adopt Option C. Build scripts/gen-package-readme-skeleton.ts as a write/--check generator cloned from scripts/gen-tsconfig-paths.ts. It should: (1) share expectedKind() with doc-standard.spec.ts (all 65 -> package-reference, VERIFIED); (2) prepend the 2-field frontmatter (description from each package.json description field, VERIFIED present 65/65; kind from expectedKind), quoting/ordering per packages/bundle/data-agent/README.md; (3) non-destructively insert the 3 missing standard headings — ## Summary (seeded from description + TODO), ## Table of Contents (auto-anchored from existing headings), ## Dev Note — leaving the already-present ## Model Experience and ## Known Limitations sections (VERIFIED 65/65) and all package-specific prose intact; mirror with 概述/目录/开发备注 in the .zh.md; (4) re-record each README.i18n.yaml via pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write per pair (sidecars VERIFIED 65/65); (5) ship a verify-package-readme-skeleton --check gate in the same change. Run once over all 65 packages -> exactly 130 files edited. Then pnpm exec vitest run scripts/doc-standard.spec.ts should go 2 failing -> GREEN. IMPORTANT scope notes for whoever applies this: (a) the retrofit must NOT touch the 6 HANDS-OFF worktrees/dirs; (b) two adjacent gates (verify-package-readme-limitations.ts, verify-package-readme-model-experience.ts) already scan all packages/*/*/README.md and are already satisfied by the 65 (both sections present 65/65) — the tool must preserve those sections; (c) the 4 plain-module packages (credentials-keychain, eval-cli, eval, retrieval-experiment) are documented as package-reference but lack apply/default exports and are absent from PACKAGE_LIBRARIES — flag for author review in case any should become a PACKAGE_LIBRARIES entry (would flip kind to package-library), do not auto-add; (d) Summary prose and zh descriptions still need human authoring — the tool only seeds placeholders.
